info.title: Guardrails demo agent
info.description: Describes the agent's HTTP API to the gateway. The gateway builds its policy evaluation context from this document, so a Cedar policy can only name fields that appear below: prompt in the request becomes context.input.prompt, result in the response becomes context.output.result. Nothing here is served to callers - the agent is main.py.

post.summary: Send a prompt to the agent and get its reply

prompt.description: The caller's prompt. Named by the input-phase policies as context.input.prompt.

result.description: The agent's reply. Named by the output-phase policy as context.output.result.
